messages:
Maya: Quick thread — drafting a lightweight customer-facing priming playbook for a pilot tenant (acme-corp). Goal: reduce cold-start latency during first 72h, capture early renewal signals, and keep ops touches minimal.
Jorge: Nice. Do you want a one-pager + checklist we can attach to kickoff?
Maya: Yes — 1 page summary + 3 action items for CS, 2 for Eng if things spike. Keep technical bits tucked in an "ops appendix".
Priya: Proposal: staged prefill -> gradual streaming enable -> fallback to cached response for repeat queries. Signal capture: record per-session engagement + NPS ping at 48h.
Sam: +1. Also include a quick health probe we can run: check token burn rate, error spike, and median latency. If median > 400ms for 15m, trigger alert.
Maya: Here's a minimal config snippet we can show customers (YAML):
```
prefill:
  strategy: staged
  phases:
    - name: seed-1
      type: static_prompts
      size: 15
    - name: stream-prefix
      type: streaming_prefill
      window_ms: 250
fallbacks:
  - name: small-quant
    model: llm-small-quant
    latency_target_ms: 350
monitoring:
  probes:
    - name: latency_median_15m
      threshold_ms: 400
```
Jorge: Love it. Can we add a quick checkbox section for CS during handoff? Eg: prefill scheduled, sample prompts uploaded, NPS cadence set, refresh token verified.
Maya: Yes — 4 checkboxes. Also add a quick troubleshooting snippet for streaming dropouts: common causes (client timeout, auth refresh, region mismatch).
Priya: For renewal risk capture, recommend a simple score: engagement_rate (0-1) * 0.6 + negative-errors*0.4; flag accounts where score < 0.55 after 7 days. Keep it easy to explain to PMs.
Sam: We'll also include an escape hatch: if overlap of requests > 75% of reserved throughput, auto-enable burst and route to dedicated pool. Devs: see routing policy snippet.
Maya: Action items: @Jorge please draft the one-pager and CS checklist by EOD Wed. @Priya add the monitoring probes and signal scoring logic. @Sam add routing/fallback bullets and a small troubleshooting table.
Jorge: On it. I'll ping for a quick review when draft done.
onboarding-bot: Reminder set — /remind @Jorge to share priming one-pager at 2026-03-25 09:00 PDT.
Priya: Quick question — should we ask customer to upload 10 canonical prompts or should we seed from product docs?
Maya: Ask them to upload 5-10 canonical prompts; we can augment with public docs but prefer customer-provided examples for higher relevance.
Sam: Final note: include example rollback steps (disable streaming, revert to cached-variant, notify CS). Keep ops runbook < 10 steps.
Maya: Perfect. If no objections I'll merge this into the customer-facing playbook repo and notify onboarding. Thanks all :rocket:
